free_tier.stated: Large allocations from 125,000 to 500,000 SUs (Horizon) and up to 50,000 (Vista) for six months duration. The first Horizon opportunity will open for demonstrating large scale science, with submissions opening April 15th 2026, and rolling reviews beginning May 15th. Horizon provides a mix of CPU and GPU computing resources, including 4,750 Dell/NVIDIA Vera CPU nodes, and 2,000 Dell/NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell nodes.

notes: The largest US number found after INCITE: 500,000 SUs on the newest NSF leadership system. SUs are a site-defined service unit, not GPU-hours or core-hours, so converting them would be invention. Classified as a refutation of the idea that the newest NSF hardware is open to anyone: it requires a US base and existing peer-reviewed funding.
